subtitle_sp_rusu_apha/sp_rusu_apha_lala_: Morning, Polina. How’s your father’s leg?
subtitle_sp_rusu_apha/sp_rusu_apha_poli_: Don't worry. The Red Army will handle it.
subtitle_sp_rusu_bvig/sp_rusu_bvig_poli_: Of course he has. I'll come by and grab it later!
subtitle_sp_rusu_bvig/sp_rusu_bvig_sci1_: Doroteya, don’t you usually have much more than this to sell?
I’ll need to change the family dinner plans then.
subtitle_sp_rusu_bvig/sp_rusu_bvig_sci2_: All my shipments were delayed this week because of the stupid barricade.
Oh Polina! I saved a loaf for your family.
Once I send half to the front lines, this is what I’m left with.
You're welcome! Your father has been bothering me for some Borodinsky.
subtitle_sp_rusu_hoco/sp_rusu_hoco_mish_: It's too bad we can't trade places. I would look great in that uniform.
Keep your voice down. You don’t want to make enemies here.
Couldn't even if I tried. My aim is shit compared to yours.
You gonna get yourself killed, climbing around up there.
subtitle_sp_rusu_hoco/sp_rusu_hoco_poli_: Fine. Just... don’t do anything I wouldn’t do.
I should be going with you.
At least try to make it back from your bomb-making.
One piece, several pieces, it’s fine. I'm pretty good at putting people back together now.
I have more practice than any of these Red Army sobaki.
I promise you can say “I told you so," if it happens.
You've made me late again, I'll have to take the rooftops.
subtitle_sp_rusu_hoex/sp_rusu_hoex_mish_: The new partisans I'm training will crush them before they get close.
You think the Germans will push into the city?
subtitle_sp_rusu_hoex/sp_rusu_hoex_sne5_: I believe it. Good luck out there!
Not if you're out there fighting!
Polina. Here to keep your brother out of trouble?
subtitle_sp_rusu_home/sp_rusu_home_bori_: It's your mother, she always insisted we display them.
Never, it's comfy enough for me.
You were a natural. I miss hearing you play.
subtitle_sp_rusu_home/sp_rusu_home_poli_: It's been a while since I played this.
Misha and I were so little in this photo.
We should replace your old chair.
subtitle_sp_rusu_host/sp_rusu_host_sne3_: Save some of our men today, da?
subtitle_sp_rusu_mebr/sp_rusu_mebr_bori_: And you make your old man proud.
If any of those ublyudki get past you.
Is it wise to give explosives to civilians?
Our comrades already know how to drink.
What do you got there? Empty bottles?
You help your country much more than you know.
You know where to send them.
subtitle_sp_rusu_mebr/sp_rusu_mebr_mish_: You know, you gonna get yourself killed having that old rifle in the house, papasha.
Blin! I need to run. They’re waiting for me!
It would've been nice to have a choice in the matter.
No... They told me that's not where I'll be the most useful so... I'm training recruits at the old post office.
Of course, papasha. They will never get through... never.
subtitle_sp_rusu_mebr/sp_rusu_mebr_poli_: At least you get to fight!
Bombs and bullets, best way to start the day.
I’ll make sure he gets these on my way to the med tents.
I swear, he will forget to keep his own head screwed on without us.
Eh, you do that well enough yourself.
So, the Germans are approaching the front line. Is that where you're off to?
subtitle_sp_rusu_mtea/sp_rusu_mtea_smeo_: Medsestra Petrova, we'll need you down by the first tent. Plenty of men that need patching up today. Go ahead and join the others...
subtitle_sp_rusu_saen/sp_rusu_saen_sgu1_: It'll be a while. If you're heading to the medical tents, you have to find another way.
Truck broke down. This way is blocked. Move along.
subtitle_sp_rusu_star/sp_rusu_star_sme1_: Get to the staging area. We have plenty of wounded.
The fighting outside the city is getting worse!
The medical officer will assign your duties. She's down on the other side of the truck.
subtitle_sp_rusu_star/sp_rusu_star_smeo_: Medsestra Petrova, you’re needed in the field. Come on, get in line!
